results.title: John Deere announces $13M to Iowa food banks, farm to plate support
results.description: The John Deere Foundation announced Tuesday it was committing $18.5 million to support food banks across the country and their connections with farmers, with $13 million of the commitment to support food banks and farmers in Iowa.

results.title: US Grocery Unit Sales Flat in September as Frozen Foods and Meat Gain
results.description: US grocery unit sales fell 0.1% year-over-year in September, but frozen foods, meat, and seafood gained while fresh produce and bakery struggled amid budget-conscious shopping.
